# pyIol2 agent map

pyIol2 is an unofficial Python client for the IOL Inversiones API v1 (REST at
`api.iolinversiones.com` plus a market-data WebSocket). It is a separate
distribution from the legacy `pyiol-client` (API v2) and shares no endpoint,
symbol format, or constant values with it. Use the repository docs as the
contract and verify names in the source before generating code.

## Canonical documentation

- Agent usage, streaming lifecycle and limits: `doc/agent-guide.md`
- Public method reference: `doc/api-reference.md`
- Read-only runnable recipes: `doc/recipes/`
- Interactive notebooks (unexecuted): `doc/notebooks/`
- Frozen vendor contract for API v1: `doc/vendor/iol-api-v1.md`
- Package exports: `pyIol2/__init__.py`
- Sync REST client: `pyIol2/client.py`
- Async streaming client: `pyIol2/stream.py`
- Dataclasses: `pyIol2/models.py`
- Constants and defaults: `pyIol2/constants.py`
- Typed errors: `pyIol2/exceptions.py`
- Token lifecycle: `pyIol2/auth.py`

## Quick map

- Construct `IOLClient(username, password)` and prefer `with IOLClient(...) as client:`; the
  REST client is synchronous. Only `IOLStreamClient` is async.
- Use typed methods for application code and `_raw()` methods only when you need the raw
  `data` payload; `_raw()` never returns `meta` or `error`.
- Catch `IOLAPIError` (subclasses: `IOLAuthenticationError`, `IOLValidationError`,
  `IOLNotFoundError`, `IOLRateLimitError`, `IOLServerError`, `IOLStreamError`) and report
  `exc.trace_id` for support.
- Use `Markets`, `SettlementTerms`, `Countries` and the `Stream*` constants instead of
  protocol literals. Defaults are `Markets.BCBA`, `SettlementTerms.T0`, `Countries.ARGENTINA`.
- Streaming needs `async with IOLStreamClient(...) as stream:` and
  `async for message in stream.subscribe([...])`; always bound the loop and `break`.
- Quotes and trades allow 50 symbols per connection, `order_book` allows 1 symbol per
  connection; sharding is automatic above those limits.
- Treat `create_order`, `create_repo`, `subscribe_fund`, `redeem_fund` and every cancel
  method as real side effects on a real account.
- Never retry an uncertain write: a timeout or 5xx does not prove the operation failed.
  Reuse the same `idempotency_key` only for the same intended submission.
- Credentials must stay in environment variables or a secret manager, and tokens must never
  be logged.
- `doc/` and `odd/` are excluded from the source distribution; the wheel contains only
  `pyIol2`. These docs are repository documentation.
